title: Use absolute cumulative commands and one continuous protected trajectory
statement: Ready labels r_g and ordered stale labels e_(g,h) carry frames g and h. Under one permanent onsite G, the actual physical command edge is Omega[u_v u_g†|e_(g,v)><r_g|+h.c.], while separate e_(a,h)->r_h resets remain CLOCK-only. The entire memory generator is conjugated by that same G once. The full register Gramian has L_prog,v*R_v=-Q_v, with active 2x2 block [[2/kappa+kappa/(4Omega²),-i/(2Omega)],[i/(2Omega),2/kappa]] and stale value 3/kappa+kappa/(4Omega²); it covers arbitrary stale coherences. The same killed memory channel runs through the whole scheduled history. A final-window joint clock tail, current-label suffix and fixed DATA decoder give error<=min(2,C N(1+T)exp(-bN)), without per-command resets/projections. Relative gate requests require external cumulative targets. The physical register changes the logical frame; no target gate is inserted into DATA recovery, and the ideal target forest inverse is still explicit.

Complete local hardware/control and separately resolved reset channels are required.
